title: Create a PC with a Template

steps.title: Create a PC with a Template
steps.content: This tour shows how to create a modern PC actor and turn it into a playable character by dropping a Template from the Character creation compendiums.

steps.selector: #actors button[data-action='createEntry'], section[data-tab='actors'] button[data-action='createEntry'], section[data-tab='actors'] button.create-document, #actors button.create-document, #actors .directory-footer, #actors
steps.title: Create a PC actor
steps.content: Click Create Actor, then choose type PC. That creates a blank modern sheet. For this tour an example PC (PC Tour) is created automatically.

steps.title: Open the PC
steps.content: Open PC Tour by clicking its name in the Actors directory.

steps.title: Blank mortal setup
steps.content: You are looking at the base PC sheet. Without a Template it behaves like a generic mortal — usable, but missing the abilities, advantages, and splat fields that make a character type easy to play.

steps.title: Find Templates
steps.content: Templates live in the system compendiums. Open the Compendium Packs sidebar.

steps.title: Character creation → Templates
steps.content: Under WoD - Character creation, open the Templates pack. That pack holds ready-made setups for Vampire, Werewolf, Mage, and many others.

steps.title: Vampire [modern]
steps.content: As an example we will use Vampire [modern]. You can pick any Template you want — or duplicate one into your world and build your own. Drag the Template onto the open PC sheet. Click Next and the tour will add Vampire [modern] for you.

steps.title: Template applied
steps.content: The sheet is now set up as a modern Vampire: abilities, advantages (such as blood pool and virtues), and vampire bio fields are in place. Create new PCs the same way with any Template from the pack. When you finish this tour, the example PC Tour actor is removed automatically.
